info.name: Flexana Mobile API (v1)
info.description:
Flexana mobile app API (updated Jul 2026).

Auth: Login with email OR phone + password. Signup: phone+email → OTP via email → verify (email+code).

Branches: GET /branches returns id + name + image + address + mapUrl. Use branchId on sessions, package-offers, service (branch-specific drop-in price), and purchase-package.

Packages: GET /package-offers?branchId= filters by branch; each package includes branchIds + branchName.

Promos: drop-in codes can be restricted to appointments and/or branches — pass sessionID on verify for drop-ins.

Package booking: isDropIn=false only allowed when session date is on/before package expiry.

Variables: base_url, bearer_token (auto-set), branch_id, signup_email, test_email, test_phone.

Import Flexana_Mobile_API.postman_environment.json and pick Local or Production.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Recommended flows:
1) Login: email OR phone + password (+ optional fcmToken).
2) Signup: phone+email → Verify (email+code+password) → token.
3) Reset password: Forgot (email OR phone) → OTP to email → Reset (same identifier + code + new password).
4) Profile phone: PUT auth/me with phone OR countryCode + phoneNumber (no OTP).
5) Email change: Send Email Change Code (newEmail) → OTP to new email → Update Me (email + emailChangeCode).

Use test_email / test_phone collection variables.

request.description: Login with email + password. Send email OR phone (not both required). Optional: fcmToken, platform (android|ios), deviceId. Token auto-saved to bearer_token.
Login with phone (E.164, e.g. +201234567890) + password. Send email OR phone. Optional: fcmToken, platform, deviceId. Token auto-saved to bearer_token.

Step 1 of signup. Body: phone (required, E.164 e.g. +201… or +44…), email (required), optional firstName, lastName, profileImage. profileImage: multipart file (profileImage) OR base64 in JSON. Max 5MB. Backend sends 6-digit OTP to email (not SMS). In local/testing, response may include code. Then call Verify with the same email + code.

Step 2 of signup. Body: email (required), code (6 digits from email), optional password, profileImage, fcmToken+platform+deviceId (register device for class reminder push). On success: emailVerifiedAt set, bearer_token saved.
Step 1 of reset flow. Body: email OR phone (one required). OTP is always sent to the account email. Response is generic. In local/testing, check logs for code.

response.name: Success
response.body: {"success":true,"message":"If that account exists, we have sent a password reset code to your email."}

request.description: Same as email variant but identify account by phone. OTP is sent to the email on file (not SMS).

response.name: Success
response.body: {"success":true,"message":"If that account exists, we have sent a password reset code to your email."}

request.description: Step 2 of reset flow. Body: email OR phone + code (from email) + password + password_confirmation (min 8).
Reset using phone as identifier. Code was sent to account email. Use same phone here as in Forgot Password (phone).
Revoke current token. Requires Bearer.
Current customer profile. Requires Bearer.

Update profile (firstName, lastName, phone, email, profileImage). Phone: send phone (E.164) OR countryCode + phoneNumber — no OTP required. Email change: first call Send Email Change Code, then PUT with email + emailChangeCode. profileImage: multipart file (profileImage) OR base64 in JSON. Max 5MB, jpeg/png/jpg/gif. Requires Bearer.
Update profile with profile image as file upload. Use form-data: firstName, lastName, email (optional), profileImage (file). Requires Bearer.
Update phone directly (no OTP). Body: either phone (E.164) OR countryCode + phoneNumber. Do not send both formats together. Requires Bearer.
Confirm email change after Send Email Change Code. Body: email (new address) + emailChangeCode (6-digit code sent to the new email). Requires Bearer.
Send OTP to the new email address before changing email. Then PUT auth/me with new email + emailChangeCode. Requires Bearer.

response.name: Success
response.body: {"success":true,"message":"Verification code sent to your new email."}

request.description: Register or refresh FCM device token. Required for Firebase push notifications including class reminders (sent by server one day before session). Body: fcmToken (required), platform (android|ios), deviceId. Also pass fcmToken on Login or Verify. Push payload when class is tomorrow: notification title "Class reminder", data.type=class_reminder, data.bookingId, data.sessionId, data.serviceName. Requires Bearer.
Change password. Requires current password. Requires Bearer.
Permanently delete the customer account and revoke all tokens. Requires Bearer.

Get active studio branches. Response: [{ id, name, image, address, mapUrl }, ...]. id is the branchId for sessions, packages, and filters. image is full URL (or null). mapUrl is a Google Maps link. Requires Bearer.
Lightweight branch list for filter/dropdown UI. Response: [{ id, name }, ...]. Only active branches. Requires Bearer.

query.description: Optional. When set, each service price reflects the drop-in price for that branch (from admin branch pricing).

response.name: Success

item.name: Schedule Screen

query.description: Optional. Comma-separated category IDs or names/slugs (e.g. 1,2 or Yoga,reformer-pilates). Only instructors with at least one matching category. Omit for all.

request.description: Response: [{ id, name }, ...]. Query: category (optional) — comma-separated category IDs or names/slugs (e.g. ?category=1,2 or ?category=Yoga). Requires Bearer.
Response: categories for schedule filters. Top-level: categories (array of { id, name } for filter UI), data (array of { category, services: [{ id, name }, ...] }). Requires Bearer.

response.name: Success
response.body: {"categories":[{"id":"yoga","name":"Yoga"},{"id":"reformer-pilates","name":"Reformer Pilates"}],"data":[{"category":"Yoga","services":[{"id":"1","name":"Gentle Vinyasa- Ladies only"}]},{"category":"Reformer Pilates","services":[{"id":"2","name":"Reformer Pilates - Ladies only L1"}]}]}

query.description: Optional: Yoga | yoga | Reformer Pilates | reformer | reformer-pilates. Filters by service category_id + keywords (vinyasa, hatha, flow, etc. = Yoga; pilates, barre, reformer = Reformer Pilates)
Optional branch ID. Filters sessions by branch. When branchId equals the default branch, older sessions with no branch may still appear.

request.description: Paginated sessions (appointments). Filter by date (YYYY-MM-DD), category (Yoga or Reformer Pilates — accepts yoga, reformer, reformer-pilates), instructorID, branchId. price uses branch-specific drop-in pricing when configured in admin. Response: { data: [{ id, bookingId, branchId, branchName, instructor, service, serviceType, price, date, dateUtc, isBooked, isFull, remainingSpots, canCancel, canBook, willPay, minutesBeforeCancellation }, ...], meta }. branchId/branchName come from the appointment branch (default branch used when none selected). remainingSpots = seats left (confirmed+pending count toward capacity). When a booking is cancelled (app or admin), spots reopen immediately. Requires Bearer.

Book one session. Body: sessionID (required), spots (optional, default 1, max 20), promoCode (optional), isDropIn (optional, default true). isDropIn false: uses package only if session date is on/before package expiry (same calendar day allowed). Sessions after expiry must use isDropIn true. Requires Bearer.

response.name: 400 No package (isDropIn false)
response.body: {"success":false,"message":"No package with remaining sessions for this category (Yoga/Reformer Pilates). Book as drop-in or purchase a package."}

response.name: 400 Package expired before session date
response.body: {"success":false,"message":"No package with remaining sessions for this category (Yoga/Reformer Pilates). Book as drop-in or purchase a package."}

response.name: 422 spots out of range
response.body: {"success":false,"message":"Validation failed","errors":{"spots":["The spots must not be greater than 20."]}}

request.description: Cancel one booking. Body: sessionID (required), customerBookingId (optional — if multiple bookings for same session). Cancellation must be before the session's cutoff (service time_before). If the canceled booking was a PAID drop-in (paymentStatus paid/completed), the backend auto-creates a package purchase credit (3 months expiry) so the customer can rebook using isDropIn=false. Requires Bearer.

Paginated list of the authenticated customer's appointments/bookings. Response: { success, data: [{ id, sessionID, branchId, branchName, serviceName, instructorName, bookedAt, bookedAtUtc, sessionDate, sessionTime, sessionStart, sessionStartUtc, sessionEnd, sessionEndUtc, status, paymentStatus, spots, totalAmount, currency, isDropIn, canCancel, minutesBeforeCancellation }, ...], meta }. branchId/branchName from the session appointment. spots = number of persons (party size). canCancel = still within cancellation window (confirmed/pending with session). minutesBeforeCancellation from service time_before. Requires Bearer.

item.description: Schedule screen. All require Bearer. Customers with confirmed/pending bookings receive email + FCM push reminders one calendar day before class (server cron; register fcmToken first). Cancelling frees remainingSpots immediately.

item.name: Packages Screen

request.description: Package offers grouped by category (all branches). Response: { data: [{ categoryId, categoryName, slug, packages: [{ id, name, price, sessions, description, expirationMonths, expirationDays, serviceType, classFormat, packageDuration, packageDurationDays, branchIds, branchName }, ...] }, ...] }. branchIds = branches that sell the package. branchName = comma-separated branch names when no branchId filter. expirationDays / packageDurationDays: exact day-based expiry when set in admin (e.g. 30-day unlimited). Requires Bearer.

request.description: Purchase one package. Body: packageId (required), promoCode (optional), branchId (optional — rejects purchase if package is not sold at that branch). Package must be active. Requires Bearer.

item.description: Packages screen. Use GET /branches first, set branch_id variable, then filter package-offers by branchId. All require Bearer token.

item.name: Promo Code Flow
item.description: Promo codes apply a percentage discount. Each code has applicable_to: both | packages | drop_ins (set in Admin → Promo Codes). Drop-in codes can optionally be restricted to specific appointments and/or branches in admin. Always verify with IsPackage before applying: true = package purchase, false = drop-in booking. For drop-ins, pass sessionID when verifying if the code is session- or branch-restricted (branch is resolved from the appointment). POST /api/v1/promo-codes/verify returns reason wrong_type, wrong_appointment, or wrong_branch when the code does not match. Then pass promoCode on session-bookings (drop-in only) or purchase-package. Invalid/expired/wrong-type codes are ignored at checkout (full price).

request.description: Validate a promo for drop-in session booking. Body: code (required), IsPackage=false (required), sessionID (optional but required when the promo is restricted to specific appointments or branches — branch is resolved from the appointment). Legacy: context=drop_ins also accepted. Returns valid, reason (not_found | inactive | wrong_type | wrong_appointment | wrong_branch | not_yet_valid | expired | usage_limit_reached), message, promo_code (includes applicable_to, restricted_to_appointments, allowed_appointment_ids, restricted_to_branches, allowed_branch_ids). Requires Bearer.

response.name: Wrong type (packages-only code)
response.body: {"valid":false,"reason":"wrong_type","message":"This promo code is only valid for package purchases.","promo_code":{"id":2,"code":"PKG10","name":"Package promo","percent_discount":10,"applicable_to":"packages","is_active":true}}

response.name: Wrong branch
response.body: {"valid":false,"reason":"wrong_branch","message":"This promo code is not valid for the selected branch.","promo_code":{"id":1,"code":"SAVE20","name":"Branch promo","percent_discount":20,"applicable_to":"drop_ins","restricted_to_branches":true,"allowed_branch_ids":[1],"is_active":true}}

response.name: Wrong appointment
response.body: {"valid":false,"reason":"wrong_appointment","message":"This promo code is not valid for the selected session.","promo_code":{"id":3,"code":"SESSION10","name":"Session promo","percent_discount":10,"applicable_to":"drop_ins","restricted_to_appointments":true,"allowed_appointment_ids":[42],"is_active":true}}

request.description: Validate a promo for package purchase. Body: code (required), IsPackage=true (required). Legacy: context=packages also accepted. Requires Bearer.

response.name: Wrong type (drop-in-only code)
response.body: {"valid":false,"reason":"wrong_type","message":"This promo code is only valid for drop-in bookings.","promo_code":{"id":1,"code":"SAVE20","name":"Summer Sale","percent_discount":20,"applicable_to":"drop_ins","is_active":true}}

request.description: Apply a promo on drop-in booking (isDropIn: true). Promo must have applicable_to drop_ins or both — verify first with IsPackage=false. Package-only promos are ignored at checkout. Requires Bearer.
Apply a promo on package purchase. Promo must have applicable_to packages or both — verify first with IsPackage=true. Optional branchId. Drop-in-only promos are ignored at checkout. Requires Bearer.

item.name: Push Notifications
item.description: Server-sent Firebase Cloud Messaging (no client API to trigger). Register fcmToken via Login, Verify, or Register FCM Token. Class reminders run daily (server cron bookings:send-class-reminders) for confirmed/pending bookings with class tomorrow — email + push.

request.description:
DOCUMENTATION — not a callable API. When a customer has an FCM token and a session tomorrow, the server sends:

Notification:
- title: Class reminder
- body: Hi {name}, your {class} class is tomorrow ({date}) at {time}. See you on the mat!

Data payload (all strings):
- type: class_reminder
- bookingId
- sessionId
- serviceName

App should handle data.type=class_reminder (e.g. open booking/session). Also sends reminder email if customer has email. Configure server: FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON, SESSIONS_CLASS_REMINDER_PUSH_ENABLED=true.

item.name: Web Schedule (public)
item.description: Public website booking flow. No Bearer token. May require WEB_SCHEDULE_ACCESS_KEY header if configured on server.

request.description: Public session list for website. Same shape as mobile sessions (isFull, remainingSpots, canBook). No auth.
Guest drop-in booking from website (on-site payment flow). International phone E.164 supported.
Initialize Paymob payment for web drop-in. promoCode must be drop_ins or both type. Returns payment iframe URL / order details.

variable.description: Branch ID from GET /branches — used for package-offers, sessions, service price, purchase-package
